facts.claim: Brindle Loop builds AI support agents for regional banks.
facts.quote: Brindle Loop builds AI support agents that answer customer questions for regional banks.

facts.claim: Their agents use LangGraph with a human approval step.
facts.quote: Our agents run on LangGraph with a human approval step for refunds and account changes.

opening: Brindle Loop puts a human approval step in front of refunds and account changes, on top of LangGraph agents that answer bank customers.

facts.claim: Quillmesh builds LLM agents that review contracts.
facts.quote: We are building LLM agents for contract review.

facts.claim: Each flagged clause links back to the page of the contract it came from.
facts.quote: Every flagged clause links back to the exact page of the source contract.

opening: Quillmesh links every flagged clause back to the exact page of the contract, which is the part of contract review agents that is hardest to get right.

facts.claim: Tallow Works makes a voice agent that books appointments for dental clinics.
facts.quote: Tallow is a voice agent that books, moves and cancels appointments for dental clinics.

facts.claim: They run a nightly evaluation on recorded test calls.
facts.quote: Every night we replay two hundred recorded test calls and score the agent on each one.

opening: Tallow Works replays two hundred recorded test calls every night to score its booking agent for dental clinics.
